name: Dawnwell: GLP-1 Pill Tracker
subtitle: Dose time, wait timer, protein
promotionalText: Take your GLP-1 tablet on time, know exactly when you can eat, and hit your protein goal. Bring a clear 30-day summary to your next visit.
description:
Dawnwell is a daily companion for people taking a GLP-1 medicine as a tablet.

Oral GLP-1 tablets come with rules that are easy to get wrong on a sleepy morning: take it on an empty stomach with a little water, then wait before you eat or drink anything else. Dawnwell keeps track for you.

TABLET AND WAIT TIMER
• A reminder at your usual time
• One tap to log the tablet, then a countdown on your Lock Screen until you can eat
• A heads-up when you are running low on tablets

PROTEIN AND HABITS
• A protein ring with quick add from a list sorted by protein
• Water, fibre, strength training and food noise in a few taps
• An afternoon nudge if you are behind on protein

SYMPTOMS AND PROGRESS
• Log nausea and other side effects with severity, triggers and a note
• Weight chart against your goal, optionally from Apple Health
• A 28-day tablet calendar

READY FOR YOUR VISIT
• A 30-day summary with questions for your clinician
• Share it as text, or as a PDF with Dawnwell Plus

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
• No account. No ads. No tracking.
• Data stays on your iPhone and syncs to your own private iCloud
• Daily copies on the phone and a backup file you control

Dawnwell only reminds and records. It never suggests or changes a dose. Medication details come from your prescription label. Always follow your prescriber's instructions.

DAWNWELL PLUS
Plus adds the PDF report and food insights. Choose a monthly or yearly subscription with a free first week, or buy Lifetime once. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel them in Settings.
